remarks: Welcome to 237 Strawberry Hill Ave #27, a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in sought-after Pinewood Estates, offering just under 2,000 square feet of light-filled living space in the heart of Stamford. Designed for today's lifestyle, this spacious home features abundant natural light, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and an open-concept main level that is perfect for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The newly updated kitchen is beautifully finished with quartz countertops and new cabinetry. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers an ensuite bath, while two additional bedrooms and a fully renovated hall bath complete the upper level. The finished lower level, with direct access from the attached private garage, offers exceptional flexibility for a home office, gym, playroom, or media room. Additional highlights include whole-house HVAC, natural gas heat, central air, a private deck, and nearby visitor parking. Pinewood Estates is a well-managed, well-maintained community with access to a fully fenced, heated in-ground pool. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Stamford's restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, as well as Barrett Park, Sterling Farms Golf Course, Glenbrook Metro-North, and Stamford Station, this is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey home in one of Fairfield County's most convenient and desirable locations.
